description: Starter multi-vendor network security compliance rule library
important_note: These are prototype rules. Exact syntax, applicability, and framework mappings must be verified before production use.

rules.title: Secure remote administration
rules.objective: Remote administrative access must use approved secure SSH settings.
expected_controls: SSH is the approved remote-administration protocol
Approved authentication methods are configured
Management access is restricted to authorized sources

rules.title: Centralized or approved administrative authentication
rules.objective: Administrative authentication must use an approved local or centralized authentication method.
expected_controls: Approved authentication source is configured
Authorization policy is defined where required
Accounting or audit logging is configured where required

rules.title: Use an approved time source
rules.objective: Network devices should synchronize time with approved organizational time sources.
expected_controls: Approved NTP server is configured
NTP authentication is used when required by policy
Time synchronization status can be verified

rules.title: Enable security event logging
rules.objective: Security-relevant events should be logged and retained according to policy.
expected_controls: Local or remote logging is configured
Relevant severity levels are captured
Remote syslog is configured when required
Log timestamps are synchronized

rules.title: Restrict network monitoring access
rules.objective: SNMP access must use approved security settings and trusted monitoring sources.
expected_controls: Approved SNMP version is used
Access is restricted to authorized monitoring systems
Default or weak community strings are not used
SNMP source or management path is controlled

rules.title: Restrict management-plane access
rules.objective: Management services must be restricted to approved administrative networks.
expected_controls: Management ACL or equivalent restriction exists
Only approved source networks are permitted
Rules do not unnecessarily allow any source
ACL is applied to the correct interface or service

rules.title: Harden unused interfaces
rules.objective: Unused network interfaces should be disabled or placed in an approved inactive state.
expected_controls: Unused interfaces are identified
Unused interfaces are administratively disabled where required
Unused interfaces do not provide unintended network access

rules.title: Protect routing-protocol sessions
rules.objective: Routing protocols should use approved authentication and peer restrictions.
expected_controls: Only approved routing peers are configured
Routing authentication is enabled where required
Routing updates are restricted to trusted interfaces or peers

rules.title: Protect access ports against rogue BPDUs
rules.objective: Access-facing interfaces should use suitable spanning-tree protection.
expected_controls: Access ports are correctly identified
BPDU protection is enabled where supported and required
Edge-port settings are not applied incorrectly to infrastructure links

rules.title: Separate management and production traffic
rules.objective: Management traffic should be isolated or appropriately restricted from production traffic.
expected_controls: Management VRF or equivalent isolation is configured where required
Management services use approved interfaces or routing contexts
Management access is restricted by ACL or equivalent controls
Unintended exposure of management services is absent
